data.name: Deflective Shield
data.description: An armor master specializes in using his shield to deflect attacks. He gains a +%1 bonus to his touch AC; however, this bonus cannot exceed the sum of the armor and enhancement bonus to AC provided by the shield that the armor master is currently carrying. This ability replaces bravery.|DeflectiveShieldBonus
